kpsue01.title: Aries Times Its Heartbreak
kpsue01.caption:
Aries put a stopwatch on getting over "let's just be friends."
The Sun had notes. Sad, but at a jog still counts. Who else tries to speed-run a feeling?

kpsue02.title: Taurus and the Comfy Rut
kpsue02.caption:
Comfort is a gift, not a hiding place.
You don't have to give up the cosy stuff to try one new thing. Bring the blanket. Say yes to the game night.

kpsue03.title: Gemini's Seven Drafts
kpsue03.caption:
Seven drafts, one "what are you up to?"
The one that sounded like Gemini was the first one. Which draft would you have sent?

kpsue04.title: Whose Birthday Is It, Cancer?
kpsue04.caption:
You look after everyone. You're allowed to be looked after too.
Let the people who love you carry the plates for once. Send this to the friend who never sits down.

kpsue05.title: Leo's First Date, Director's Cut
kpsue05.caption:
Leo planned a spotlight entrance, three outfits and a rehearsed laugh.
The Sun played the date and counted the questions. Stay for the verdict. Ever been out-listened on a first date?

kpsue06.title: Virgo's Fix-Me-First List
kpsue06.caption:
You don't have to be finished to be loved.
The loud laugh, the long texts, the plants: someone will love those. Start the list with being kind to yourself.

kpsue07.title: Libra Loves Hiking (Libra Hates Hiking)
kpsue07.caption:
Libra agreed to hiking, extra spice and 5 a.m. runs. Libra likes naps.
Turns out the date did too. What have you pretended to love on a first date?

kpsue08.title: Scorpio Opens One Window
kpsue08.caption:
Trust is built a little at a time.
You don't have to open the whole fortress on date three. Share one small true thing and see who shares back.

kpsue09.title: Sagittarius Said "Sometime"
kpsue09.caption:
Sag said "let's hang sometime" to eleven people.
The Sun made it pick a day. Now it's everyone's Thursday. Tag the friend whose sometime never comes.

kpsue10.title: Capricorn After the Promotion
kpsue10.caption:
"I'll date after the promotion," three years running.
Your heart isn't a five-year plan. Leave room for one dinner with friends this week, and close the laptop.

kpsue11.title: Aquarius Files a Bug Report
kpsue11.caption:
Aquarius filed a ticket: unexpected warmth when they text.
The Sun closed it as a crush. Status: working as intended. Ever tried to debug a feeling?

kpsue12.title: Pisces, Main Character
kpsue12.caption:
You hold everyone's heart. Who holds yours?
Cheering for your friends' love stories is beautiful. You deserve one too, and it starts with how you talk to yourself.
